results.title: General Manager – Logistics Stockyard (Automotive)
results.description: The Job Summary The General Manager leads Petromin Logistics' stockyard as a profitable, customer-focused and technology-driven automotive logistics business. The role owns the full P&L, acquires and retains vehicle-brand accounts, and delivers reliable service across the vehicle lifecycle, driving the stockyard's launch and growth through digital operations, financial discipline and continuous improvement. Key Performance Indicators / Measures: • Revenue, operating profit and cash flow vs. the approved business plan • Customer margin, cost per vehicle and capacity utilisation • New vehicle-brand accounts won and growth of existing accounts • Customer satisfaction, retention and SLA achievement • Vehicle turnaround, dispatch reliability and PDI first-time-right • Damage, rework and claims recovery • Digital and AI use cases delivered, with measured gains in productivity, accuracy and cost • Safety, quality and business-continuity performance; team capability The KPIs listed in this JD define what the role is measured on; specific targets and weights are set and may be adjusted annually through the performance management cycle, in agreement with the line manager. Technical / Job-Specific Competencies 1 Business Plan & P&L Ownership Own the stockyard business plan, budget and P&L, and drive pricing, cost control, billing and collections, to deliver revenue, profit and cash targets. 2 Profitability & Investment Manage profitability by customer and service, cost per vehicle and break-even utilisation, and build investment cases for capacity and technology, to secure measurable returns. 3 Strategic Account Acquisition Personally lead account acquisition with Business Development, winning OEM, vehicle-brand, importer and distributor business through strong relationships and competitive proposals, to grow and diversify revenue. 4 Contracts & Account Growth Negotiate contracts and service levels with Finance and Legal, and grow existing accounts in line with operational capacity, to secure profitable, sustainable business. 5 Digital Strategy & Systems Lead the stockyard's digital strategy, integrating YMS, ERP, transport and customer systems, to give real-time vehicle visibility, accurate inventory and digital workflows. 6 AI & Automation Adoption Prioritise and implement AI and automation for capacity planning, vehicle allocation, damage detection, predictive maintenance and reporting, with Corporate IT ensuring data quality, security and responsible AI use, to lower cost and raise productivity. 7 Stockyard Launch & Operations Lead readiness, launch and daily operations across receipt, storage, stock preservation, PDI, VAS, customs coordination and dispatch, and control outsourced service performance, to run a reliable, efficient stockyard. 8 Customer Experience & SLAs Deliver customer SLAs, resolve escalations and improve turnaround, productivity and vehicle condition through standard procedures and root-cause problem-solving, to raise satisfaction and retention. 9 People Leadership Develop accountable managers and digitally capable teams, and align workforce capacity and shared-service levels with business needs, to deliver the business plan. 10 Safety, Quality & Governance Own safety, quality, vehicle custody and business continuity, oversee damage prevention and claims recovery, and strengthen the Integrated Management System, reporting performance and risks to the CEO, to protect people, vehicles and the business. The Job Profile 1 Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or a related discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. 2 Professional Certifications No mandatory certification. A logistics or supply chain certification (e.g., ASCM CLTD / CSCP, CILT) is an advantage. 3 Experience 15+ years of relevant experience, including 5 years in senior leadership with direct P&L accountability; Saudi or GCC experience is preferred. 4 Essential Job Pre-Requisites Strong finished-vehicle logistics experience (stockyard operations, PDI, transportation, outsourced services), including launching or substantially improving a stockyard or comparable operation. Proven personal success winning and retaining OEM, importer, distributor or major logistics accounts. Demonstrated delivery of YMS, WMS, TMS or ERP integration or comparable digital transformation, with measurable results. 5 Languages Proficiency Fluency in English and Arabic is mandatory.

results.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Shipping & Logistics
results.description: The Chief Operating Officer (COO) will be a key member of the executive leadership team and will have overall responsibility for driving operational performance, service excellence, productivity, efficiency and sustainable growth across the logistics operations. The COO will provide strategic and operational leadership across the company's integrated logistics platform, covering Freight Forwarding – Sea, Air and Land, Procurement, Customs Clearance, Yard Management, Land Transportation and Fleet, Service Centers, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI), Warehousing and Contract Logistics. Working closely with the CEO and other members of the leadership team, the COO will translate the company's strategy into effective operating plans, establish consistent operating standards, strengthen cross-functional integration and ensure that the organization is positioned for scalable and profitable growth. The role carries significant responsibility for operational and financial performance, with partial P&L accountability, while maintaining a strong focus on customer retention, operational excellence, digital transformation, business expansion and organizational capability. The successful candidate will be expected to build a high-performance operating culture, improve utilization of people and assets, enhance customer experience, strengthen governance and controls, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the company's competitive position. Key Responsibilities: Overall Operations Leadership: Lead and oversee all UAE operational activities across Sea, Air and Land Freight Forwarding, Procurement, Customs Clearance, Yard Management, Land Transportation & Fleet, Service Centers, PDI, Warehousing and Contract Logistics. Operational Strategy: Develop and execute the UAE operations strategy in alignment with the company's overall business objectives and growth plans. Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement, standardization, productivity, efficiency and cost optimization across all operational functions. Integrated Operations: Ensure seamless coordination and integration between freight forwarding, customs, transportation, fleet, yards, warehouses, PDI and contract logistics to deliver end-to-end logistics solutions. Financial Performance: Take partial P&L responsibility for operations, with accountability for operating costs, productivity, margins, budgets and efficient utilization of resources and assets. Customer Retention & Service Excellence: Drive operational service quality and customer retention by ensuring consistent service delivery, timely resolution of operational issues and strong performance against customer commitments. Business Transformation: Lead operational transformation initiatives, including process re-engineering, automation, digitalization and data-driven performance management. Growth & Expansion: Support the CEO in identifying and implementing opportunities for business expansion, new services, capacity development, strategic partnerships and operational investments. Fleet & Asset Optimization: Maximize utilization and productivity of fleet, equipment, facilities, yards, warehouses and other operational assets while maintaining appropriate maintenance and safety standards. Procurement & Supplier Management: Provide strategic oversight of operational procurement and supplier performance, ensuring competitive sourcing, cost efficiency, service quality and strong supplier governance. Performance Management: Establish and monitor operational KPIs, dashboards and performance-management routines, ensuring clear accountability and timely corrective action across all operational departments. Risk, Compliance & HSE: Ensure operations comply with applicable UAE regulations, customer requirements and company policies, with strong focus on safety, security, risk management and business continuity. People & Leadership: Lead, coach and develop the operational leadership team, building a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, customer service and continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with the CEO, Finance, Commercial, HR, IT and other functions to ensure effective execution of the company's strategic and operational priorities. Executive Reporting: Provide the CEO and executive leadership team with regular reporting and insights on operational performance, financial results, customer issues, risks, opportunities and strategic initiatives. Key Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Maritime Studies, Operations Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 15 to 25 Years Experience in Supply Chain Management. Executive leadership certifications and professional memberships are advantageous. Experience managing large-scale, multi-site, or multi-country operations is highly desirable. GCC/UAE experience preferred. Personal Attributes: Visionary and entrepreneurial leader. Results-oriented with a strong commercial mindset. Highly proactive and resilient. Strong executive presence and communication skills. Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities. Able to lead through change and drive business transformation. High integrity, professionalism, and accountability.

results.title: Director of Vehicle Management
results.description: Green SM is a leading electric vehicle and sustainable mobility solutions provider headquartered in Vietnam. With a commitment to transforming urban transportation, we have successfully expanded into Global Market and are now preparing to launch operations in the Dubai Market. Join us in driving the future of sustainable mobility. Job Description Lead the end-to-end vehicle management strategy, covering vehicle procurement, receiving, storage, registration, deployment, maintenance, utilization, and retrieval. Develop and implement vehicle management policies, SOPs, and operational standards to ensure fleet efficiency, safety, and reliability. Oversee vehicle maintenance, servicing, inspections, and overall vehicle condition to ensure fleet readiness. Manage vehicle insurance, claims, documentation, and coordination with insurance providers. Oversee vehicle management across warehouses, stockyards, depots, and operational locations. Ensure smooth and timely vehicle registration, documentation, and deployment processes. Monitor fleet performance, utilization, availability, and operational costs, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Lead and develop the Vehicle Management team while working closely with Operations, Maintenance, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Automotive, Logistics, Operations Management, or a related field. Minimum 12 years of experience in vehicle/fleet management, automotive, logistics, mobility, or related industries, with proven experience in a leadership role. Strong experience in fleet operations, vehicle maintenance, registration, insurance, and asset management. Proven track record in leading teams and managing large-scale fleet operations. Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Strong understanding of operational controls, cost management, safety, and regulatory requirements. Willing to travel and support operations across different locations

results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Head of Logistics Transformation & Operations
results.description: Our Client An established food manufacturing group in Oman is looking to transform its distribution operations into an integrated, future-ready logistics network. Your Role Think Network Design. Think Transformation. Think Build & Run . We are looking for a seasoned logistics leader to design, consolidate and lead the Group's distribution network across ambient, chilled and fresh product categories. Key Responsibilities Design and implement an integrated Group-wide distribution network. Consolidate logistics operations, warehouses, fleets and resources across businesses. Establish and lead a centralized, shared-services logistics function. Optimize warehousing, transportation, fleet utilization and last-mile delivery. Build e-commerce fulfilment capabilities and support new routes to market. Drive CAPEX/OPEX planning, technology adoption, cost efficiencies and service improvements. Lead the transformation and take full ownership of ongoing logistics operations. Must Have 15+ years in logistics, supply chain and distribution leadership. Proven experience in both designing/restructuring distribution networks and subsequently running them. Strong FMCG, food manufacturing or multi-category distribution background. Experience across ambient and temperature-controlled distribution. Demonstrated success in logistics consolidation, shared services and operational transformation. Strong commercial understanding of distribution economics, CAPEX/OPEX and logistics technology. Proven ability to lead large teams and complex change initiatives. We want someone who has built, transformed and run complex distribution networks, delivering measurable business results. Next Steps If this opportunity matches your experience and ambitions, please upload your resume through our application system. Our team will review your profile and contact shortlisted candidates within 5–7 working days. Mindfield Resources | Making a Difference

results.title: Team Leader , Logistics
results.description: About noon We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Team Leader, Logistics who can help us move even faster. Noon’s fastest hyper-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localised assortment of FMCG & grocery products with delivery within 15 minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time. noon’s mission: Every door, every day. What you’ll do: Effectively manage the assigned fleet across 3-5 Dark Stores within the cluster, consistently meeting target KPIs. Supervise Fleet Managers, overseeing daily operations to ensure the smooth and efficient execution of fleet activities. Ensure rigorous adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compliance with all operational standards. Support efficient manpower allocation across all stores in the cluster Mentor and guide the team, fostering high performance and proactively addressing operational challenges. Maintain clear, timely, and effective communication with all stakeholders to ensure complete operational alignment. What you’ll need: Minimum 2 years of experience in Logistics, managing teams. Excellent communication and coordination skills. A hands-on approach—willing to roll up your sleeves and get involved. Comfortable working in highly ambiguous situations and adapting to change. Understanding of logistics metrics and ability to manage stakeholders effectively. Flexibility in work schedule to accommodate operational needs. Who will excel? We’re looking for people with high standards who understand that hard work matters. You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action. We need people with the courage to be fiercely original. noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

results.title: Logistics & Mobility Director
results.description: MARAFID is the execution arm of Riyadh Holding Company, specializing in the development and activation of economic infrastructure across three core sectors: Logistics & Mobility, Industrial Clusters, and Circular Economy. We bring together development, asset management, leasing, and strategic partnerships to translate these sectors into projects and services that support business activity and serve the needs of operators, tenants, and investors. Our focus spans logistics parks, truck stations, parking facilities, specialized industrial hubs, and infrastructure for material aggregation, reuse, and recycling. Digital solutions and shared services support the management of these assets and their connections with the businesses they serve. Through collaboration with public and private sector partners, MARAFID connects land, infrastructure, and operational expertise to support Riyadh’s economic growth. We are currently seeking a Logistics & Mobility Director to manage and coordinate MARAFID’s logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, overseeing sector assets, services, and ecosystem participants to ensure effective service delivery, operational performance, and sustainable growth of the sector. 1. Key Responsibilities Oversee logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, coordinating activities across MARAFID’s relevant assets, facilities, services, and sector initiatives. Manage the operational performance of sector assets and services, monitoring utilization, service levels, revenues, costs, and other key operational indicators. Coordinate with operators, tenants, service providers, and ecosystem partners to ensure effective integration and delivery of services across the logistics and mobility ecosystem. Identify and implement operational improvement opportunities to enhance asset utilization, service quality, efficiency, customer experience, and overall ecosystem performance. Support the launch and operationalization of new logistics and mobility offerings, ensuring the effective transition of new projects and services into ongoing operations. Monitor sector demand, customer needs, and operational trends to identify opportunities to enhance existing services and inform future ecosystem development. Coordinate with relevant corporate functions to support effective and compliant operations. 2. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of relevant experience in logistics, mobility, operations, asset management, service delivery, or a related field. Strong understanding of operational performance, service delivery, asset utilization, and key operational indicators. Strong stakeholder management, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Fluency in Arabic and English.

results.title: Head of Freight Forwarding, Shipping & Customs
results.description: Own and grow FLOW's freight forwarding and shipping business across sea, air and multimodal trade lanes—leading commercial performance, carrier and agency relationships, and operational execution to deliver profitable, reliable freight services. Responsibilities Lead P&L for sea, air, multimodal forwarding and shipping / liner-agency operations. Set commercial strategy for trade lanes, pricing and carrier contracts. Drive volume and margin growth across key accounts and target verticals. Build relationships with shipping lines, airlines, NVOCCs and customs partners. Ensure booking, documentation, customs clearance and on-time delivery excellence. Manage and develop the freight forwarding and shipping team across FLOW's markets. Qualifications & Competencies Bachelor’s degree in business, Logistics or a related field 10+ years in freight forwarding / shipping, including leadership roles Strong carrier, agency and regulator network in KSA / GCC Proven P&L ownership and commercial negotiation track record

results.title: Head of Logistics
results.description: The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in logistics management. This role requires a strategic thinker who can manage a diverse team and optimize processes. Based in Dubai, UAE, you will play a key role in shaping our logistics strategy and enhancing our brand's reputation in the highly competitive e-commerce market. RESPONSIBILITIES: Management of the logistics processes in the Middle East Lead warehousing, transportation, and distribution operations: supervise warehouses, control the movement of goods within the region, and ensure timely and accurate product delivery to customers Strategic decision-making Develop and manage the logistics budget, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial targets Employee development and training, improving employees’ qualification and boosting motivation Analyze and research customer needs to develop the optimal approach for meeting them REQUIREMENTS: Higher education in Logistics or a related field 5-7 years of management experience in logistics and supply chain management within FMCG, beauty, fashion, or pharmaceuticals, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role Fluency in English (both spoken and written), Arabic – as an advantage Deep industry expertise in transportation, warehousing (WMS), inventory management, distribution, and order fulfillment Experience in B2C e-commerce Hands-on experience working with 3PL partners (managing tenders, evaluating KPIs, system integration) Project experience (cost optimization, system integration, etc.) will be an an advantage

results.title: Head of Operations
results.description: Job Purpose: Responsible to manage, lead and develop strategically-oriented operational platforms that mean to efficient delivery FM and EM services in the regional markets, with the objective of prioritizing and optimizing the resulting value from contracted scopes, consistent with the strategy of the client organizations and within the resource capabilities required for that. To build collaboration and support across managed portfolios to effectively blend a need for formal and structured processes with clients desire to quickly respond to the needs of stakeholders involved. Primly account to the strategic fulfillment of operations within the assigned portfolio of assets/ buildings at Contract Sites in assigned Regions while implementing best supplier and customer relationship management, facilities management, building energy services management, maintenance, that improve the overall operational efficiency of managed assets, maintain high customer satisfaction, and help achieve business objectives. Duties & Responsibilities: Operations & Facilities Management Monitor SLAs for the portfolio of assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, customer expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability. Monitor service delivery performance and participate in the evaluation of suppliers’ performance for Sites in the assigned Regions to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers/ contractors at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service. Monitor resource utilization for Site Operations in the assigned Regions to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives. Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the assets/ facilities (including maintenance to BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.). Monitor the process of quotation requests, and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays. Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted. Leadership Participate and recommend actions to maximize the effective achievement of the Site Contract’s objectives through leading the Site Operations team in the assigned Regions, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance. Organization Structure Contribute and assist the Country Director in defining an optimum structure for the division so that resources are optimally utilized and communication takes place in an efficient manner. Budgets & Plans Participate in the budgeting process for the Site Operations business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized. Lead and manage Sites in the assigned Regional Operations departments while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed objectives. Discuss “Site-Specific-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible. Qualifications: 15+ years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role Exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management especially in the areas of operations planning, HSEEQ, supplier relations management, client relations management, maintenance, and contract management
